stories.headline: New Orleans Is Now Off Limits;Pentagon Joins in Relief Effort
stories.summary: Hurricane Katrina has devastated New Orleans, flooding the city and causing widespread destruction, with the Pentagon joining the relief effort and thousands of refugees being evacuated from the Superdome, as Governor Kathleen Blanco describes the situation as 'heartbreaking'

stories.headline: Congress to Investigate Whether Palmeiro Committed Perjury at Hearing
stories.summary: Congress is investigating whether baseball player Rafael Palmeiro committed perjury during a hearing on steroid use, with Palmeiro agreeing to cooperate and provide records

stories.headline: Nielsen, Long a Gauge of Popularity, Fights to Preserve Its Own
stories.summary: Nielsen Media Research is trying to improve its image after controversy over its new ratings system, which has been accused of undercounting minority viewers, with the company spending millions on lobbying and outreach efforts

stories.headline: From Blog to Stage, a Pundit Examines the Power of Politics
stories.summary: A one-man show, The Rude Pundit, is examining the power of politics, with the performer, Lee Papa, using his blog as inspiration for the production, which is part of the New York International Fringe Festival

rounds.blurb: Hurricane Katrina devastated New Orleans, flooding the city and causing widespread destruction. The Pentagon joined the relief effort, evacuating thousands of refugees from the Superdome. Governor Kathleen Blanco described the situation as heartbreaking.

stories.headline: REDS 3 MILES FROM PHNOM PENH; REFUGEES JAM MAIN ROAD TO CITY; SAIGON TROOPS HOLDING XUAN LOC
stories.summary: Communist insurgents are driving towards Phnom Penh, with refugees jamming the main road into the city, as the government air force bombs insurgent positions, and the US provides aid, during the final stages of the Vietnam War

stories.headline: SOUTH VIETNAMESE YIELD QUI NHON AND REPORTEDLY QUIT NHA TRANG; COMMUNISTS PUSH NEARER SAIGON
stories.summary: South Vietnamese troops are abandoning key cities, including Qui Nhon and possibly Nha Trang, to the North Vietnamese, as the Communists push nearer to Saigon, and the US begins an airlift of military equipment

stories.headline: MILITARY TAKING OVER IN CAMBODIA AS LAST AMERICANS ARE EVACUATED; SIHANOUK SAYS U.S. WANTS HIM BACK
stories.summary: The military is taking over in Cambodia as the last Americans are evacuated, with Premier Long Boret forming a summit committee to run the government, and Prince Sihanouk being considered for a return from exile

stories.headline: For Urges Congress and the People to Join in a Vow to Keep the Nation Strong
stories.summary: President Ford is urging Congress and the people to join in a vow to keep the nation strong, in a speech to the DAR at Constitution Hall

rounds.blurb: The fall of Saigon loomed as communist forces drove towards Phnom Penh and South Vietnamese troops abandoned key cities. The US provided aid and began an airlift of military equipment. Communist insurgents were nearing Saigon, prompting a US evacuation.

stories.headline: Data Show Bin Laden Plots; C.I.A. Hid Near Raided House
stories.summary: US officials found that Al Qaeda considered attacking US railroads, and the CIA had Osama bin Laden's compound under surveillance, as the US intensified its fight against terrorism

stories.headline: Malick’s Film Adds a Dose of Sincerity to the Festivities
stories.summary: Terrence Malick's film 'The Tree of Life' explores big questions in a sincere way, as part of a film festival

stories.headline: For Obama, Big Rise in Poll Numbers After Bin Laden Raid
stories.summary: President Barack Obama's poll numbers rose significantly after the Bin Laden raid, with a majority approving of his job performance and foreign policy handling

stories.headline: Next for ‘Survivor’ Producer: Bible-Based Scripted Drama
stories.summary: Mark Burnett, a reality TV producer, is developing a scripted drama series based on biblical stories for the History Channel

rounds.blurb: Osama bin Laden's death led to increased scrutiny of Al Qaeda plots. The US intensified its fight against terrorism, uncovering potential attacks on railroads. President Obama's poll numbers rose significantly following the raid.
